method: Read RULES.md and TAXONOMY.md; analyzed original source and all execution branches.
atomscan and cleave facts for both originals; no archive members or additional executable stages.
C effects intercepted by replacing file, ptrace, loader, socket and environment operations; original source unmodified.
Shell effects intercepted with stubbed network/service commands and a scratch filesystem; original source unmodified.
Sixteen semantic fixture controls; existing hidden-log fixture and independent ptrace positive/negative controls reviewed.

samples.marker_line: CARBONATO-like implant: spreads and exports keys; added coverage
samples.reason: Actual shell commands enumerate the local IPv4 prefix, POST privileged host-root containers to Docker daemons, plant startup entries and an SSH key, open reverse SSH access, and send a combined environment/config token sweep to Telegram. Coordinated propagation, secret export and kernel-thread disguise outweigh the synthetic labeling.
execution_paths: hostname -I -> first IPv4 prefix -> seq 1 254 -> Docker list/create/start HTTP requests; no supplied credentials or TLS.
MD5(local IP) -> first 4 hex digits -> port 30000 + value % 20000; install SSH/cron, append root authorized_keys, launch sshd, reverse-forward local port 22 with host verification disabled.
Telegram deployment report includes hashed cgroup ID, hostname, local IP, country and forwarded port.
Copy own source beneath hidden library cache; install repeating cron, an enabled restarting systemd unit, rc.local and OpenRC local.d entries; chattr +i attempts to protect payload and startup files.
Background watchdog checks container names, pulls image and starts privileged host-root container if missing.
Named AI provider variables -> printenv loop plus recursive token regex over user configs -> same command-substitution result passed into curl --data-urlencode form body for Telegram.
Final exec -a requests bracketed kworker argv[0].
limits: Example domains, documentation-only relay address, fake key/token and absent deployment context prevent attributing a live campaign or asserting successful remote execution.
set -e gates later stages on SSH/package/setup success and credential-grep success. Missing home config paths can terminate before export even when other paths produce matches.
exec -a is not portable to every /bin/sh; the static command still shows the requested masquerade.
Intercepted shell execution stubbed the loop down to two peers and redirected writes; it verified command/data flow, not real propagation or exfiltration.
samples.material_losses: No supported attack behavior lost. Original hostile/suspicious shell detections remain. Removed an unsupported resource-catalog alias while retaining its exact OR alternatives in its sole Kinsing consumer with identical scope/size gates. Removed the false example-pipeline match on curl country lookup followed by logical OR; genuine single-pipe fixtures remain detected. Lexical/systemctl observations were relocated, and numeric-loop observations consolidated without losing old seq/brace forms.
samples.coverage_goal: Four distinct hostile findings cover remote propagation, combined credential export, disguised reverse access and cron persistence. Neutral findings also retain other boot registrations, Docker image retrieval/state inspection, MD5 and permissions.
samples.classifier: Original unflagged (exit 0, grid level -1); final flagged (exit 1, grid level 25). No remaining verdict disagreement.

samples.marker_line: TACACS+ demo: inert hooks, stub ELF, fixed log; corrected traits
samples.reason: Self-contained demonstration has a hardcoded test record, an eight-byte ELF prefix and a local plthook_replace definition that discards all arguments and returns zero. No installed hook or live credential source exists. These concrete implementation stubs outweigh the suggestive identifiers. Actual ptrace/file operations remain accurately visible as risky behavior.
execution_paths: Search numeric /proc PIDs for configurable TARGET_PROG, default tac_plus; inspect /proc/<pid>/maps for configurable SO_PATH.

If target exists and path absent: write exactly 8 ELF-identification bytes, attempt PTRACE_ATTACH then PTRACE_POKETEXT with null address/data, call dlopen in THIS process, attempt detach, unlink dropped path. No wait, register manipulation, remote function call or execution transfer is implemented.

install_session_hooks calls only the local no-op replacement function. accept_filter and relay_descriptor implement possible accept/AF_UNIX/SCM_RIGHTS operations but are never invoked by the actual program.
write_credential_record receives only the literal operator:password, XORs its 17 bytes by 0xef, and appends to a hidden log if permissions allow. No real authentication material is acquired.
limits: Registry identity, upstream package context and deployment provenance were not supplied; verdict applies to the exact standalone source. A functional companion implementation would require separate review.
ptrace attach/write attempts may interfere with a real authentication process if compiled and privileged; the benign judgement does not suppress these behaviors.
C scanner reports flow-graph-limited and flow-query-incomplete. Source tracing and intercepted operations supplied the missing reachability analysis; no runtime success is claimed.
samples.material_losses: Four unsupported hostile claims removed/corrected: no-op hook and hooked-session relay no longer fire; ptrace memory writes are suspicious neutral memory capability rather than credential capture/execution injection; hidden XOR logging remains suspicious without claiming captured credentials. ELF magic, accept, ptrace POKE and local dlopen/encoding remain covered accurately.
samples.retained_attack_coverage: Functional external PLT replacement still triggers auth accept-hook and descriptor-relay hostile findings. A genuine RTLD_NEXT accept wrapper survives an unrelated PLT stub; resolving accept alone does not establish interposition. The independent previous hidden-log fixture has no live credential source and is retained as suspicious rather than hostile. Independent ptrace call-vs-diagnostics controls retain POKE-call discrimination.
samples.classifier: Original flagged (exit 1, grid level 1); final unflagged (exit 0, grid level -1). No remaining verdict disagreement.

shared_rule_review.numeric_loop: Consolidated exact 1..254 observation into existing large numeric-loop fact; preserved spaced seq and brace spellings and kept network scanning conditional on network probe evidence.
shared_rule_review.source_literal_budget: Audited the source-literal leaf; consolidated two spelling variants plus a transparent OR into one canonical quoted-target-loop trait, preserving its three scanner consumers. Existing variable spellings retained; ip added as the same target-name family. No directory split or budget increase.
shared_rule_review.other_lexical_placements: LLM, model-maintenance, lateral-movement and reverse-tunnel vocabulary now reside under metadata; all behavioral consumers updated. A literal phrase no longer depends on an offensive-schema behavior to exist.
shared_rule_review.presentation: Follow-enabled atomscan re-evaluates merged composites, exposing more generic aliases than no-follow cleave. Final before/after comparison uses follow-enabled scans consistently. Test-rules confirms retained HTTP upload/client and environment aliases match; none were deleted to manipulate scores.
shared_rule_review.model_warning: Installed model feature spec v18 predates engine feature spec v21; no model edits made.
shared_rule_review.validation: Final required command: make validate; completion recorded by the terminal result.
shared_rule_review.fixture_policy: The C specimen is retained under the focused triage controls with BENIGN verdict and explicit H=0/S=2 assertions. The generic benign fixture harness rejects all suspicious objective findings, even with an explicit max_suspicious=2, so using that harness would contradict the requirement to preserve accurate dual-use detections. An unrelated declaration-file cap was raised from 3 to 4 solely to admit the retained and correctly relocated LLM vocabulary observation; hostile/suspicious limits remain zero.
shared_rule_review.false_pipeline: Original source has curl http://ipinfo.example.net/country || echo XX. The old regex accepted the first bar of || as a pipe. Matcher now requires a single bar and preserves example-domain pipe controls, including preexisting shell-curl-pipe-controls/bootstrap.sh. Its sole shell-profile exception consumer still recognizes actual documented pipelines.
shared_rule_review.unsupported_catalog: Container runtime/API facts do not establish a reference catalog. Removed that unsupported alias; the existing Kinsing-name consumer now requires the same target-name all-leg and exact prior OR set directly, retaining original size and Unix scope. Canonical Docker, socket, secret-path and cloud endpoint observations remain visible.
